country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: ISO 3166 2-letter country code to disambiguate the search.

options.tooltip: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US, GB, CZ. Narrows the city or postal code search. Required for postal code lookup.
Type a city, e.g. Prague, and optionally set the Country code below to narrow it. Then use Find & confirm location to pin the exact place, or leave it empty to resolve automatically at run time.
Click Find & confirm location to search using the City name and Country code above, then pick the exact match. Leave empty to resolve the city name automatically at run time.
Type a postal/ZIP code, e.g. 11000; a Country code below is required. Then use Find & confirm location to pin the exact place, or leave it empty to resolve automatically at run time.
Click Find & confirm location to search using the Postal code and Country code above, then pick the exact match. Leave empty to resolve the postal code automatically at run time.

location_search.title: Location Search Query
location_search.description: Search text for finding an AccuWeather location key.

options.tooltip: Type a city or postal code, then use Find & confirm location below to look up and pick the matching AccuWeather location key, or paste a known key directly into that field.
Click Find & confirm location to search using the query above and pick a match, or paste a known AccuWeather location key here.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: Which weather datasets to pull for this location.

current_conditions.title: Current Conditions
current_conditions.description: Latest observed conditions for the location.

current_conditions_details.title: Current Conditions – Include Full Details
current_conditions_details.description: Fetch the extended detail fields for current conditions.

options.tooltip: Adds extra columns to the current conditions table: realfeel_temperature, relative_humidity, wind_speed, uv_index, visibility, cloud_cover and pressure.

daily_forecast.title: Daily Forecast
daily_forecast.description: Multi-day daily forecast for the location.

daily_range.title: Daily Forecast Range
daily_range.description: Number of forecast days to request.

daily_forecast_details.title: Daily Forecast – Include Full Details
daily_forecast_details.description: Fetch the extended detail fields for the daily forecast.

options.tooltip: Adds extra columns to the daily forecast table: realfeel_temperature_min/max, hours_of_sun, day/night wind speed and direction, day/night thunderstorm and rain probability, uv_index and air_quality_category.

hourly_forecast.title: Hourly Forecast
hourly_forecast.description: Multi-hour hourly forecast for the location.

hourly_range.title: Hourly Forecast Range
hourly_range.description: Number of forecast hours to request.

hourly_forecast_details.title: Hourly Forecast – Include Full Details
hourly_forecast_details.description: Fetch the extended detail fields for the hourly forecast.

options.tooltip: Adds extra columns to the hourly forecast table: realfeel_temperature, wind_speed and wind_direction, relative_humidity, dew_point, uv_index, visibility, cloud_cover, precipitation_type and rain amount.

indices.title: Lifestyle Indices
indices.description: Daily lifestyle indices for the location.

indices_range.title: Indices Range
indices_range.description: Number of days of indices to request.

indices_ids.title: Indices Filter
indices_ids.description: Optional. Leave empty to output all indices, or list the AccuWeather index IDs to keep (e.g. 1, 5, 26). See the full index list at https://developer.accuweather.com/documentation/indices

options.tooltip: Restricts the indices output to the listed AccuWeather index IDs. Leave empty to keep every index. Find each index ID and name in the AccuWeather index list at https://developer.accuweather.com/documentation/indices
